title: Gridfinity: Your Ultimate Modular Workshop is FREE!
summary: Zack Freedman introduces Gridfinity, his free, open-source modular workshop storage system of 3D-printable bins and baseplates. The video walks through the design, the parametric templates and the many module types that fit parts, tools and accessories.
why: HN points people to it as the original explanation of what Gridfinity is and why it exists, in threads about the project and its catalogs.

quote.text: Watching Zack's original video on the concept really helps to cement why this exists.
